features: Wireless Karaoke Microphone: Enjoy endless karaoke fun with the included wireless microphone. Perfect for singing, parties, family gatherings, and performances, it lets you enjoy clear voice transmission without the hassle of wired connections.
RGB LED Lights: Bring your music to life with vibrant RGB LED lights that create a colorful and energetic atmosphere, making every karaoke session or party more exciting.
Bluetooth 5.3 Connectivity: Stream your favorite playlists wirelessly with Bluetooth 5.3, ensuring stable connectivity and smooth audio playback for a hassle-free listening experience.
Up to 5 Hours Playtime: Enjoy up to 5 hours of entertainment on a single charge, making the Apollo Prime suitable for karaoke sessions, gatherings, and everyday music listening.

USB Flash Drive, AUX-In & SD Card Support: Enjoy versatile connectivity with USB, AUX, and SD card support, allowing you to play music from compatible devices and enjoy your favorite tracks with ease.
Type-C Charging: Recharge conveniently with the Type-C charging port, ensuring your speaker is ready for your next listening session.
Easy Grip Handle: Carry your speaker with ease using the built-in grip handle, making it convenient to take your music and karaoke entertainment wherever you go.
description: The Portronics Apollo Prime is a powerful Bluetooth speaker with a wireless karaoke microphone, designed to deliver an enjoyable audio experience for music, karaoke, and entertainment. Its HD sound output produces clear vocals and punchy bass, while the included wireless microphone makes it perfect for singing, parties, and family gatherings. RGB LED lights add vibrant visual effects to create an energetic atmosphere. With Bluetooth 5.3, USB flash drive, AUX-In, and SD card support, the Apollo Prime offers versatile connectivity for all your favorite music sources. The up to 5 hours of playtime ensures extended entertainment, while Type-C charging provides convenient recharging. Finished with an easy grip handle, the Apollo Prime is a portable and versatile speaker for everyday listening and karaoke fun.
